title: Introduction To Linguistics I
modules: Language, The Brain And The Mind
Grammar And Types Of Grammars I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a second language for Nigeria in the sense that every Nigerian is assumed to speak at least one native language or mother tongue."
English is a second language for Nigeria in the sense that every Nigerian is assumed to speak at least one native language or mother tongue.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to using a phrase or word that is not offensive."
The sexual act is referred to using a phrase or word that is not offensive.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a direct outcome of multilingual situations."
Language planning is a direct outcome of multilingual situations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an example of a densely multilingual situation with about 510 languages spoken by 140 million people."
Nigeria is an example of a densely multilingual situation with about 510 languages spoken by 140 million people.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to differences at various levels of language."
Variation refers to differences at various levels of language.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phenomenon of language variation, which assumes that no language is a uniform entity and that a language varies according to the place, time and context in which it is used."
Diaglossia Diglossia is a phenomenon of language variation, which assumes that no language is a uniform entity and that a language varies according to the place, time and context in which it is used.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of sounds and the patterns they form in a speaker's grammar."
Phonology is the study of sounds and the patterns they form in a speaker's grammar.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a similar type of error as malapropism."
Spoonerism is a similar type of error as malapropism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the sounds that we produce with a disturbance of the air tract in our mouth like /p, b, t, d, k, m, n, , s, z, f, v/ etc."
Consonants are the sounds that we produce with a disturbance of the air tract in our mouth like /p, b, t, d, k, m, n, , s, z, f, v/ etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a word or phrase that replaces a taboo word or serves to avoid offensive subjects."
A euphemism is a word or phrase that replaces a taboo word or serves to avoid offensive subjects.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the overt or covert reaction of language users to the languages which exist in their community, and the users of such languages (Ansa 2002: 46)."
Language attitude is the overt or covert reaction of language users to the languages which exist in their community, and the users of such languages (Ansa 2002: 46).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the system or mechanism with which a speaker creates sentences from words."
Grammar refers to the system or mechanism with which a speaker creates sentences from words.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act of writing down the sounds of a language using the phonetic symbols of the IPA chart."
Transcription is the act of writing down the sounds of a language using the phonetic symbols of the IPA chart.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term used to refer to the customs and speech of Africans and Europeans born in the new World (Holm 1988:9)."
Creole is a term used to refer to the customs and speech of Africans and Europeans born in the new World (Holm 1988:9).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sub-discipline of linguistics and involves the application of linguistic theory to the field of Speech-Language Pathology."
Clinical Linguistics Clinical Linguistics is a sub-discipline of linguistics and involves the application of linguistic theory to the field of Speech-Language Pathology.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the branches of linguistics."
Sociolinguistics is one of the branches of linguistics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the coexistence of two languages within a speech community."
Bilingualism and Multilingualism Bilingualism refers to the coexistence of two languages within a speech community.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sociolect or social dialect based on ethnicity."
American English (AAE) is a sociolect or social dialect based on ethnicity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an English-based pidgin widely used in Papua, New Guinea."
Tok Pisin is an English-based pidgin widely used in Papua, New Guinea.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the language for kinship structure in a given society."
Terms of address refers to the language for kinship structure in a given society.
fib: ______ refers to the negative influence of an acquired language over another language being learned.
Language interference
Language Interference Language interference refers to the negative influence of an acquired language over another language being learned.
______ are the outcome of the discovery that languages have certain aspects in common while other aspects are unique to specific languages.
Language universals
Language universals are the outcome of the discovery that languages have certain aspects in common while other aspects are unique to specific languages.
______ refers to any cognitive functions that are primarily localised to one side of the brain or the other (From kin et al 2003: 61).
Lateralisation
Lateralisation refers to any cognitive functions that are primarily localised to one side of the brain or the other (From kin et al 2003: 61).
______ refers to the time or a state of an event.
Tense
Tense refers to the time or a state of an event.
______ is used for formal occasions and in written texts whereas the 'low' is used in colloquial conversation.
'high
The 'high' is used for formal occasions and in written texts whereas the 'low' is used in colloquial conversation.
______ refers to the definition of the mind as one which tries to rescue the essence of man.
Cardoso
Cardoso refers to the definition of the mind as one which tries to rescue the essence of man.
______ can be defined as vocabulary that is unique to a particular group of individuals.
Jargon
Jargon can be defined as vocabulary that is unique to a particular group of individuals.
______ is the science of patterns; it is by finding such patterns that knowledge is compressed.
Mathematical Linguistics Mathematics
Mathematical Linguistics Mathematics is the science of patterns; it is by finding such patterns that knowledge is compressed.
______ are made up of sounds and their meaning.
Words
Words are made up of sounds and their meaning.
______ are used in communicating government issues and in promoting national cohesion.
National languages
National languages are used in communicating government issues and in promoting national cohesion.
______ is the presence in a language of two varieties used for distinct functions - a 'high' (H) and low (L).
Diglossia
Diglossia is the presence in a language of two varieties used for distinct functions - a 'high' (H) and low (L).
______ is the application of the principles and methods of linguistics and phonetics to communication impairment in children and adults.
central focus of Clinical Linguistics
The central focus of Clinical Linguistics is the application of the principles and methods of linguistics and phonetics to communication impairment in children and adults.
______ is the study of linguistics using mathematical methods of analysis.
Mathematical linguistics
Mathematical linguistics is the study of linguistics using mathematical methods of analysis.
______ is the use of a shared set of signs or symbols within a society to interact and express their feelings, ideas and emotions.
Language
Language is the use of a shared set of signs or symbols within a society to interact and express their feelings, ideas and emotions.
______ is the coexistence of more than two languages within a speech community or society.
Multilingualism
Multilingualism is the coexistence of more than two languages within a speech community or society.
______ is defined as the minimal meaningful unit of grammatical analysis.
morpheme
A morpheme is defined as the minimal meaningful unit of grammatical analysis.
______ is the study of speech sounds.
Phonetics
Phonetics is the study of speech sounds.
______ is considered to be the most refined and complete sign system in the world and it is used mostly in the United States of America and Canada.
ASL
ASL is considered to be the most refined and complete sign system in the world and it is used mostly in the United States of America and Canada.
______ is concerned with the psychological mechanism underlying speech production and reception.
Psycholinguistics
Psycholinguistics is concerned with the psychological mechanism underlying speech production and reception.
